y_failures: Introduces the Heremitae p.19 preface as 'As Paracelsus writes', but the quoted text speaks of 'the disciples of the most wise Theophrastus' and 'my peers, the Galenists', so it is by someone else, not Paracelsus.
reason: X's quotations and definitions all check out against the Faust, Borch, Lémery and Waite pages, apart from small embellishments such as salt coming from 'calcination of the dregs'. Y is well sourced and more vivid, but it puts a preface by another author into Paracelsus's mouth, which the page contradicts.
